risk_if_not_implemented: Without Inbound & Outbound Communications Traffic, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Inbound & Outbound Communications Traffic (MON-22) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure event log and security-relevant telemetry reviews include analysis and triage practices that integrate with the organization's established incident response processes.
compensating_control_2.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage (MON-05.2) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Inbound & Outbound Communications Traffic (MON-22) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
